title: Educational Award Scheme - Gujarat Labour Welfare Board

scheme.name: Educational Award Scheme - Gujarat Labour Welfare Board
scheme.summary: The Educational Award Scheme encourages the children of laborers to increase their enthusiasm and pursue higher education.
eligibility: Parents must be working in a factory/institute in Gujarat and paying the Labour Welfare Fund.
Children must have passed 70% and above marks in the 10th or 12th Standard.
scheme.benefits: Children who scored 70% or above in 10th Standard receive ₹2,500/-, and in 12th Standard receive ₹5,000/- as an award.
documents: Identity proof of Child i.e. Aadhaar Card
scheme.how_to_apply: Applicants may apply online through the Sanman Portal by registering, filling out the application form, uploading documents, and submitting.

summary.value: The Educational Award Scheme encourages the children of laborers to increase their enthusiasm and pursue higher education.
summary.quote: The “Educational Award Scheme” is implemented by the Gujarat Labour Welfare Board, Labour, Skill Development & Employment Department, Government of Gujarat. The scheme has been implemented to encourage the students of the Labours to increase their enthusiasm and to get higher education through it.

eligibility.value: Parents must be working in a factory/institute in Gujarat and paying the Labour Welfare Fund.
eligibility.quote: Only the children (students) whose parents are working in a factory/institute in the state of Gujarat and whose parents have been paying the Labour Welfare Fund will be eligible for this scheme.

eligibility.value: Children must have passed 70% and above marks in the 10th or 12th Standard.
eligibility.quote: The children of labourers who have passed 70% and above marks in the 10th or 12th Standard can avail the benefits under the scheme.

benefits.value: Children who scored 70% or above in 10th Standard receive ₹2,500/-, and in 12th Standard receive ₹5,000/- as an award.
benefits.quote: 1. Under the scheme, children of laborers who have passed 70% or above marks in the 10th Standard will receive ₹2,500/- as an award. 2. The children of laborers who have passed 70% or above marks in the 12th Standard will receive ₹5,000/- as an award.

documents.value: Identity proof of Child i.e. Aadhaar Card
documents.quote: 10. Identity proof of Child i.e. Aadhaar Card

how_to_apply.value: Applicants may apply online through the Sanman Portal by registering, filling out the application form, uploading documents, and submitting.
how_to_apply.quote: Step 01: The applicant may visit the Sanman Portal: https://sanman.gujarat.gov.in/ ﻿ Step 02: On the home page, under the tab ‘Citizen Login’, click on ‘ Please Register Here’. Step 03:Enter your Aadhaar Card Number, select user type, and then enter Labour Welfare Fund Account Number. Step 04: Now, click on ‘Fetch’ & verify the details. Step 05: Enter user details and Password. Step 06:After successful registration, the applicants can login through their User ID and Password. Step 07:Now, select the scheme and read the instructions carefully for the selected scheme. Step 08: Fill out the application form and upload all the relevant documents. Step 09: Agree with the Rules & Regulations and submit the application form. A confirmation email with the application Number will be sent on the registered email ID.
